name: Takasaki Nozomi
source:
Likes: Family, Housework, Children, Insects, Sweets
Dislikes: There is a little clumsy aspect to her.


Ikuto's step-mother. The main heroine of this game, she's still a virgin. A nursery school teacher who Ikuto meets at his part time job, who is older than him. Even though Ikuto yearns for her after feeling her overwhelming motherhood on their first meeting, she becomes his step-mother after his father remarried her.

For Ikuto, who doesn't have a mother, she wants to be an ideal mother and takes care of housework, which is her specality. Not just that, she worries about Ikuto who is inexperienced about women, so thinking for his future, she resolves to use her own body to teach him about women. That skinship becomes commonplace and gradually escalates with no way of stopping.

[As a mother, I have to teach you about women properly.]
[spoiler]
In her route, it was found out that Ikuto' father didn't submit their marriage registration papers, and mistakenly brought them with him on his trip. So, she and Ikuto's father are just engaged, not married.
